query:
SELECT 
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN token_symbol = 'USDC' THEN amount END), 0) as total_usdc_paid,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN token_symbol = 'USDT' THEN amount END), 0) as total_usdt_paid,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN token_symbol = 'ETH' THEN amount END), 0) as total_eth_paid,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN token_symbol = 'STRK' THEN amount END), 0) as total_strk_paid,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN token_symbol = 'WBTC' THEN amount END), 0) as total_wbtc_paid
        FROM group_token_history
